feature_groups.heading: Why choose CelestialEve
feature_groups.intro: More Than a Stay, It's an Experience

items.label: A Home Away from Home
items.body: Enjoy thoughtfully designed accommodations that combine modern comfort with a warm, welcoming atmosphere, making every stay relaxing and memorable.

items.label: Peaceful Natural Surroundings
items.body: Escape the noise of everyday life and unwind in beautiful green surroundings where fresh air, open spaces and nature create the perfect setting for relaxation.

items.label: Convenient and Connected
items.body: Located in Demoville, CelestialEve is perfectly positioned near major business hubs – Brussels Airport (25km), Brussels City Center (20km) and Mechelen (20km). Experience peace & privacy with easy access to where business happens.

items.label: One-Price Concept
items.body: We keep it simple: our One-Price Concept ensures simple, transparent pricing with no hidden costs. Inclusions are clearly detailed per service, so you always know what to expect.

items.label: Perfect for Every Celebration
items.body: From weddings and birthdays to anniversaries and family reunions, our versatile spaces provide the ideal backdrop for life's most special moments.

items.label: Comfort Meets Convenience
items.body: Relax in cozy accommodations with thoughtfully selected amenities that help you enjoy a comfortable, stress-free stay.

items.label: Moments You'll Remember
items.body: Whether you're here to celebrate, reconnect or simply unwind, every experience at CelestialEve is designed to create lasting memories.

items.label: Ideal for Groups
items.body: Whether you're planning a family vacation, friends' getaway or corporate retreat, CelestialEve offers comfortable spaces designed to bring everyone together.

quote.quote: what we love most is creating a place where guest feel cared for, connected and completely at ease.
quote.author: The CelestialEve Team

feature_groups.heading: Technologies
feature_groups.note: We intentionally do not support video conferencing. CelestialEve is designed to foster genuine, in-person interaction in a focused and inspiring environment.

feature_groups.heading: Amenities
feature_groups.intro: Each detail is designed to enhance your experience, ensuring comfort, productivity and inspiration throughout your time at CelestialEve.

items.label: Coffee Corner
items.body: Enjoy a continuously stocked coffee corner with complimentary beverages to keep you refreshed throughout the day.

items.label: Natural Daylight
items.body: Large windows flood the rooms with daylight, creating a bright, energising and productive work environment.

items.label: Inspiring Views
items.body: Admire the serene views of the surrounding fields – a peaceful backdrop that fosters focus, creativity and calm.

items.label: Outdoor Terrace
items.body: Step outside for a breath of fresh air. Ideal for informal chats, coffee breaks or simply enjoying nature between sessions.

items.label: The Summer House
items.body: A cozy, detached space ideal for breakout sessions, private calls or quiet focus – filled with natural light and views of the grounds.

feature_groups.heading: What's Included
feature_groups.intro: Our One-Price concept means everything you need is included, with no surprises at checkout. Every stay at CelestialEve features:

items.label: Breakfast Crafted for You
items.body: Start your day the right way.

items.label: Private Bathroom
items.body: Walk-in shower (and a bathtub in Executive Suite 2).

items.label: Access to all Facilities
items.body: Terraces, Spa (fitness & sauna) and Summer House.
